description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Neuralink is creating brain-computer interface devices and a surgical robot designed to enable communication between the brain and digital systems. The Software Engineer - Simulation will own end-to-end simulation of the surgical robot, including building the simulator, testing software and firmware against simulated hardware, automating verification, and reproducing hardware failures.
Robotics simulation engineer building dynamics, sensor and actuator models, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and CI validation

Responsibilities:
• Build the full robot sim: dynamics, sensors, actuators, and product-stack interfaces
• Test the real robot software and firmware against simulated hardware
• Write automated sim tests: scenarios, regressions, fault injection, and coverage
• Make runs deterministic, measurable, and cheap enough to run in CI
• Reproduce hardware failures in sim to accelerate our test timelines
• The success of the project is on you. You talk to users, get feedback, and iterate fast

Requirements:
• Strong Rust skills; Python for test tooling and analysis
• Real robotics / physics sim experience (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or equivalent)
• Experience with async and concurrent systems, hardware interfaces, RPC, and telemetry
• Experience building automated integration tests and debugging failures across software and firmware
• Effective at using AI agents to accelerate work while maintaining quality
• Bachelor's degree in a technical field (Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, etc.) or equivalent practical experience

Preferred:
• Bazel experience is a plus
